completeness.why: All four sites pass their own enable flag and mode to getDateWithWeekendRule (or its string wrapper getDateStringWithWeekendRule, which delegates to it); getNextDate folds its site-only noSkipWeekend option into the flag it passes, which the rubric allows as a variation existing only at that site.

interface.why: The function takes exactly the real variation (flag, mode) with each caller mapping its own field names, but the string wrapper re-checks skipWeekend itself and then passes a literal true, so the enable test is written twice in the shared module.
